login.title: Log in to your account
login.subtitle: Manage your manuscripts, orders, and books at Tartila Press.
login.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Please log in with your new password.

register.title: Registration
register.subtitle: Create a new account and start publishing books

password.hint: At least 8 characters, combining uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
password.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
password.needsCase: Password must contain both uppercase and lowercase letters.

forgot.title: Forgot Password?
forgot.intro: Enter your account email. We will send you a link to create a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If {{email}} is registered, we have sent a link to create a new password. The link is valid for 60 minutes.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing yet? Check your spam folder and make sure the email address is spelled correctly.
forgot.throttled: You are requesting links too often. Please wait a moment and try again.

reset.incomplete: This password reset link is incomplete. Request a new link to continue.
reset.rejected: The password reset token is invalid or has expired. Request a new link to continue.
reset.title: Create a New Password
reset.throttled: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

pending.title: Check Your Email
pending.bodyWithEmail: We have sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open that email and click the Verify Email button. If it is not in your inbox, check your spam folder.
pending.body: We have sent a verification link. Open that email and click the Verify Email button. If it is not in your inbox, check your spam folder.

success.title: Email Verified Successfully
success.body: Thank you! Your account is now verified and can be used in full.

already.title: Email Already Verified
already.body: Your email has already been verified. There is nothing more to do.

invalid.title: Invalid Link
invalid.body: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link to continue.
invalid.loginFirst: Log in first to resend the link.

changed.title: Email Changed Successfully
changed.body: Your account email has been changed and is already verified. For your security, please log in again with your new email.

taken.title: Email Already in Use
taken.body: That new email is already used by another account, so it cannot be set on this account. Request an email change again with a different address.

change-invalid.title: Invalid Link
change-invalid.body: This email change link is invalid or has expired. Request the email change again from the Account page.

resend.throttled: You are requesting emails too often. Please wait a moment and try again.

banner.text: Your email has not been verified. Open the email we sent and click the verification button (also check your spam folder).
